provenance: Entirely synthetic customer feedback; not historical quotations.

notes.note: I start in the program list when checking which programs need attention. I did not know there was a separate reporting page.
When I am editing a program, I am focused on its settings. I review activity after I finish or from the overview.
I need to compare programs before deciding which one to investigate. A filtered report is useful once I have chosen one.

counter_evidence: These three fictional notes illustrate plausible needs; they cannot establish representativeness or prove the cause of lower dashboard usage.
